Photographically coherent backlit lawn (trunk, bench and off-frame tree shadows all fall consistently away from the sun; edges hold only a blurred parked car and buildings), but the distant tower is a crenellated square tower with one arched opening — the softest, most rendered element and a silhouette that a UK eye can read as a parish-church tower (no cross, clock or iconography, so not a Rule-C hit).

Highly convincing rain-wet walkway (puddle mirrors the maples and glass buildings correctly; muddy boot print in the paving; far-end shapes zoomed are trunk/bollard smears, not figures), but the alt says 'crisp autumn light' while the scene is soft overcast after rain with the puddle as its dominant feature — alt should say rain-wet under soft overcast light.
